info.name: OrderFlow — Guided Local API Evidence Run
info.description: A guided, manual-order Postman collection for the OrderFlow Go/Gin modular monolith. Import it, set the local mock callback secret only in Postman Current Value, and run each request in sequence. It expects an existing local ADMIN user (defaults to the previously used local test admin). Do not use against production. Do not export or share populated secrets/tokens. Screenshots guidance is in docs/postman/ORDERFLOW_POSTMAN_ATOMIC_STEPS.md.

request.description: Prometheus-text counters and histogram; this request itself increments the metrics.
Pre-request creates a unique local demo email each time. Keep this local-only.
Uses the already-created local ADMIN user. Edit adminEmail/adminPassword in collection Current Value if your local account differs.

item.name: 02 — Create product A for order tests (expect 201)

body.raw: {"sku":"{{sku}}","name":"OrderFlow Postman Product A","description":"Temporary local evidence product A","price_paise":49900,"initial_stock":50}

item.name: 03 — Create product B for multi-product order (expect 201)

body.raw: {"sku":"{{sku2}}","name":"OrderFlow Postman Product B","description":"Temporary local evidence product B","price_paise":12500,"initial_stock":50}

exec: pm.test('same idempotency request replays with 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 04 — Reuse order key with different payload (expect 409)

exec: pm.test('different payload with same key returns 409', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
